cascadeInspection: Independent review compared the authenticated complete Relume Header11 anatomy with the final DOM, CSS cascade, media lifecycle, and all nine cache-busted render states. One full-small-viewport ren-cover section owns one flexible media region with exactly one local cover video and one scrim, one progressively enhanced pause/play control, and one constrained bottom copy band containing exactly one h1, one description, and two real CTA links. The band remains source ordered, stacks through 767px, changes to two equal top-aligned columns at 768px, and wraps actions without clipping at 320px. Reduced motion starts paused and remains user-controllable; JavaScript-disabled rendering retains native video controls and suppresses the decorative scrim so those controls remain legible. Desktop light/dark, paused, 768, 767, 390, 320, reduced-motion, and no-JavaScript captures preserve the intended hierarchy, viewport coverage, focus and 44px targets. No navigation, logo, form, image, dialog, third action, duplicate chevron or control, overflow, framework code, raw flex/grid skeleton, forbidden palette token, or chromatic literal remains.
